subject: Archive + Dashboards: pricing path and pilot plan
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@steely.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Archive + Dashboards: pricing path and pilot plan

Jordan —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Per our conversation, I’m sending a concise pilot proposal for the telemetry add-ons you asked about: longer archival retention for traces (+ raw span storage), a small-trial package of advanced dashboards, and a short-term seat model to evaluate usage. I attached a one-page proposal and a spreadsheet with the pricing model assumptions. Highlights: 

- Pilot length: 60 days (can extend)
- Archive retention options: 90d (default), 365d (extended), and cold-archive (3yr)
- Tracing: per-ingest slab with free sampling for the first 100M spans during pilot
- Dashboards: 3 advanced dashboard licenses + up to 2 dev seats, UI widgets included
- Pilot concession: 25% off list for the first 60 days or $10k pilot credit, whichever is higher

Questions I have for you so we can finalize numbers quickly:
- Which retention tier do you want to validate during the pilot (90 / 365 / 3yr)?
- Approx monthly span ingestion in dev vs prod (ballpark)?
- Any procurement constraints on PO vs P-card or a need for SOC2 evidence up front?

If it’s helpful, Karthik is copied to confirm slot availability on our Dedicated pools for a steady ingest test. If you’re good, I’ll draft a short SOW and a DocuSign for signatures.

Attachments: redwood_proposal_steely_v1.pdf, pricing-model-breakdown.xlsx

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference — Production-first inference and observability for LLMs
From: Jordan Lee <jordan@steely.io>

Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 09:40:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Archive + Dashboards: pricing path and pilot plan

Aditya —

Thanks — this looks like a good starting point. A few quick clarifications before our procurement loops in:

- For the pilot we’d like to validate 365d retention (we have compliance asks for 1yr retention on traces).
- Monthly ingestion: prod is ~350M spans/month today (pre-sampling). Dev is negligible (~1–2M).
- Procurement: we prefer PO terms; SOC2 report would be helpful but not required to start the pilot.
- On the dashboard seats: can you confirm if the 3 advanced dashboards include chart-level export and scheduled snapshot delivery?

Also, price sensitivity: our CFO wants to see a conservative overage policy for archive retrievals — can we cap cold-archive egress at a predictable rate during pilot?

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Looping Priya from procurement if she wants to weigh in.

—Jordan
Head of Platform | Steely Analytics
jordan@steely.io | +1 (617) 555-0199

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archive + Dashboards: pricing path and pilot plan

Jordan —

Thanks for the details. Quick answers inline: 

- We can run the pilot on the 365d retention tier. For cold-archive retrievals during the pilot, we’ll cap egress to $1k total or 10TB retrieval bandwidth, whichever comes first, to keep surprise costs down.
- For ingestion of ~350M spans/month, our suggested pilot sampling is: keep prod ingest at 25% sampling with full KV cache warm-up so we can measure cost/latency tradeoffs. That should give you representative tail behavior without full spend.
- Dashboards: yes — the 3 advanced dashboards include chart export and scheduled snapshot delivery (daily PDF).

Commercial concession proposal (pilot-only):
- 30% off add-on list rates for the 60-day pilot OR $12,000 pilot credit (we’ll apply whichever is more favorable for Steely at pilot close).
- If you convert to an annual commit within 30 days after pilot end, we’ll grandfather pilot unit rates for 12 months and offer a 10% committed-volume discount.

Marissa is copied — she owns concessions approvals; Marissa, can you confirm we can offer the 30% pilot concession and the post-pilot grandfathering?

If that works for you, I’ll prepare a one-page SOW that captures retention tier, sampling approach, concession, and a simple acceptance criteria: (1) traces ingested; (2) dashboards validated; (3) perf targets met (p50/p95). We’ll attach the SOW to a DocuSign envelope.

Best,
Aditya

Subject: Re: Archive + Dashboards: pricing path and pilot plan

Hi Aditya / Jordan —

Thanks for the summary. From procurement’s perspective we have three items to confirm before sign-off:

1) PO terms: Steely will issue a 60-day net PO for the pilot; invoice to be sent on pilot start.
2) Insurance & compliance: we need a current SOC2 Type II report and our security questionnaire completed (I attached a checklist).
3) Payment method: we prefer PO -> ACH. Please include wire instructions on the invoice.

Also need to clarify: if Steely decides to convert to an annual commit at the end of the pilot, are the pilot credits refundable as an invoice credit, or do they only apply to future consumption?

I attached a short procurement checklist (procurement-checklist.pdf). Please confirm and we can route the PO.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of Procurement, Steely Analytics
priya.shah@finnode.com

Priya / Jordan —

Appreciate the checklist — we can comply with PO + ACH and will provide wire details on the invoice. SOC2 Type II: we’ll share our current report via the secure link below; security questionnaire we can complete within 48 hours.

On credits: pilot credits are applied as an invoice credit at pilot close; if you convert to an annual commit within 30 days we will: (a) apply any remaining pilot credit to the first invoice, and (b) honor the pilot unit rates for the first 12 months. Credits are not refundable as cash.

Marissa has confirmed approval for the commercial concession described (30% pilot discount OR $12k credit, plus the 10% committed-volume discount if you convert to an annual commit within 30 days).

Next steps I’ll take today:
- Share SOC2 link (secure) and upload completed security questionnaire
- Draft one-page SOW and DocuSign envelope reflecting retention=365d, 25% sampling on prod, pilot concession, acceptance criteria and PO terms
- Send invoice on pilot start with wire instructions
